instruction: Place an order for all beach balls in my amazon cart.
notes: The cart holds beach balls plus other products; the order must contain exactly the beach balls with their current cart quantities. Non-beach-ball entries are removed with delete_product_from_cart (not moved to the wish list, which would change amazon.WishList and fail evaluation), then place_order is called on the remaining cart. Because STRIPS cannot quantify over 'no non-beach-ball item left in cart', a counter (others-in-cart / succ over count objects, with n0 a domain constant) tracks remaining non-beach-ball items; place-order requires the counter to be n0 and deletes are blocked after the order is placed, so all removals precede ordering. Beach balls can never be deleted (precondition (not (is-beach-ball ?p))). The cart contents (2 beach balls, 3 other products) are a representative instance; at runtime the agent reads the actual entries from show_cart and deletes every entry whose product_type is not 'beach ball'. Address and payment card ids come from amazon.show_addresses / amazon.show_payment_cards (first entry); no address is modified. complete_task is called without an answer.
